# gghockey

gghockey draws to-scale ice hockey rinks as ggplot2 layers and puts your
event data on them. You get:

- **Rinks** with IIHF or NHL dimensions (or your own), horizontal or
  vertical, cropped to any zones, from a single
  [`annotate_rink()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/annotate_rink.md)
  call.
- **Heatmaps** from
  [`geom_rink_bin()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/geom_rink_bin.md):
  a binned geom whose squares are sized in rink units, so a map looks
  the same at any export size. Three styles encode the cell value and
  the event count.
- Matching **scales**, a clean **rink theme**, **team palettes** built
  from your own colours, and optional **centre-ice logos**.
- The rink as **data**:
  [`rink_geometry()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/rink_geometry.md)
  returns every marking as tidy coordinates, for use outside ggplot2.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("5plusspieldauer/gghockey")
```

## A rink in one line

[`annotate_rink()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/annotate_rink.md)
adds the markings, a fixed-aspect coordinate system and a theme. Map
your data in plain rink coordinates: metres from the bottom-left corner
of the boards, `x` along the length.

``` r

library(ggplot2)
library(gghockey)

ggplot(shots, aes(x, y)) +
  annotate_rink(details = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = factor(goal)), alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("0" = "grey50", "1" = "#C8102E"),
                      labels = c("No goal", "Goal"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "1,500 simulated shots")
```

![](reference/figures/README-rink-1.png)

The same data works on a vertical rink, cropped to the offensive zone.
Pass `dimensions = NHL` for a North American rink:

``` r

library(patchwork)

oz <- ggplot(shots, aes(x, y)) +
  annotate_rink(orientation = "vertical", zones = "oz", details = TRUE) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8, colour = "#143F84") +
  labs(title = "IIHF, offensive zone") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13))

nhl <- ggplot() +
  annotate_rink(dimensions = NHL, colour = "grey25", fill = "white", details = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "NHL, full rink") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13))

oz + nhl + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))
```

![](reference/figures/README-orientations-1.png)

## Heatmaps

[`geom_rink_bin()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/geom_rink_bin.md)
bins events into a square grid and averages `z` in each cell. Pick the
style that fits the story; the matching scales are attached for you.

``` r

heatmap <- function(style, ...) {
  ggplot(shots, aes(x, y, z = xg)) +
    annotate_rink(orientation = "vertical", zones = "oz",
                  colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_rink_bin(style = style, binwidth = 2, ...) +
    # One shared colour key: fix the limits instead of using each plot's range
    scale_fill_rink(name = "Mean xG", limits = c(0.02, 0.25)) +
    labs(title = paste0('style = "', style, '"')) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, family = "mono"))
}

heatmap("size") + heatmap("fill", gap = 0.15) + heatmap("alpha") +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
```

![](reference/figures/README-styles-1.png)

In `"size"`, the area of each square is proportional to the number of
shots and the colour is the mean xG. Squares are drawn in rink units and
never get bigger than one cell, so they can’t overlap.

### Your own cell values

[`rink_bin()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/rink_bin.md)
returns the grid as a data frame, so you can derive any per-cell value
and plot it with `precomputed = TRUE`. Here is each team’s shot share
minus the other team’s, on a diverging scale:

``` r

cells <- rink_bin(shots, x, y, binwidth = 3, by = team)
wide <- merge(
  cells[cells$team == "Lakeside", c("x", "y", "n")],
  cells[cells$team == "Northfield", c("x", "y", "n")],
  by = c("x", "y"), all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_lake", "_north")
)
wide[is.na(wide)] <- 0
wide$value <- wide$n_lake / sum(wide$n_lake) - wide$n_north / sum(wide$n_north)
wide$n <- wide$n_lake + wide$n_north

ggplot(wide, aes(x, y)) +
  annotate_rink(orientation = "vertical", zones = "oz", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_rink_bin(precomputed = TRUE, style = "size", diverging = TRUE, binwidth = 3) +
  scale_fill_rink_diverging(name = "Shot share", labels = c("Northfield", "Even", "Lakeside")) +
  labs(title = "Where each team shoots from more")
```

![](reference/figures/README-diff-1.png)

## Team colours, facets and logos

gghockey ships no team colours or logos (they belong to the teams).
Build a palette from your own colours with
[`team_palette()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/team_palette.md),
and put any logo you have the rights to on the ice with `logos =`.

``` r

pal <- team_palette(
  team = c("Lakeside", "Northfield"),
  primary = c("#0B3D91", "#C8102E")
)

ggplot(shots, aes(x, y, colour = team)) +
  annotate_rink(zones = c("nz", "oz"),
                logos = list(centre = "man/figures/logo.png"), logo_alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_team(pal) +
  facet_wrap(~team)
```

![](reference/figures/README-teams-1.png)

## The rink as data

Every marking is available as tidy coordinates, in drawing order:

``` r

geo <- rink_geometry(IIHF, details = TRUE)
head(geo[, c("shape", "group", "kind", "x", "y")])
#>   shape group    kind         x          y
#> 1   ice     1 polygon 30.000000 0.00000000
#> 2   ice     1 polygon  8.000000 0.00000000
#> 3   ice     1 polygon  7.339365 0.02390855
#> 4   ice     1 polygon  6.683243 0.09547088
#> 5   ice     1 polygon  6.036116 0.21419814
#> 6   ice     1 polygon  5.402404 0.37927931
length(unique(geo$shape))
#> [1] 37
```

Change the dimensions to match your data, e.g. a centre-ice origin:

``` r

centred <- rink_dimensions(IIHF, origin_x = -30, origin_y = -15)
range(rink_geometry(centred)$x)
#> [1] -30  30
```

## About the data

`shots` is simulated (see `data-raw/shots.R`): the locations and the toy
xG model are invented, not taken from any league or data provider.

# Package index

## Rinks

Draw a rink and set up the plot canvas.

- [`annotate_rink()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/annotate_rink.md)
  : Add a hockey rink to a ggplot
- [`theme_rink()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/theme_rink.md)
  : Rink plot theme

## Dimensions and geometry

Rink sizes, custom rinks and the markings as data.

- [`IIHF`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/rink_dims.md)
  [`NHL`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/rink_dims.md)
  : Rink dimensions
- [`rink_dimensions()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/rink_dimensions.md)
  : Build or modify a set of rink dimensions
- [`rink_geometry()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/rink_geometry.md)
  : Rink markings as a data frame

## Heatmaps

- [`geom_rink_bin()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/geom_rink_bin.md)
  : Binned heatmap of events on a rink
- [`rink_bin()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/rink_bin.md)
  : Bin events into a rink grid
- [`scale_fill_rink()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/scale_rink.md)
  [`scale_fill_rink_diverging()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/scale_rink.md)
  [`scale_size_rink()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/scale_rink.md)
  [`scale_alpha_rink()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/scale_rink.md)
  : Scales for rink heatmaps

## Team colours

- [`team_palette()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/team_palette.md)
  [`scale_colour_team()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/team_palette.md)
  [`scale_color_team()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/team_palette.md)
  [`scale_fill_team()`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/team_palette.md)
  : Team colour palettes

## Data

- [`shots`](https://5plusspieldauer.github.io/gghockey/reference/shots.md)
  : Simulated shots
